1. System Architecture & Ingestion Pipeline

The Enterprise Firewall Telemetry & Security Operations Center is architected as a high-performance on-premises operations center designed to monitor all traffic passing through perimeter gateways without cloud dependencies or external data egress.

Core Components

  • Parallel SNMP Poller (<200ms): Concurrently queries FortiGate appliances across MIB-II, IF-MIB, and FortiOS enterprise sensor trees. Tracks 64-bit High Capacity (HC) octets, thermal zones, fan tachometers, dual power supplies, and security policy accounting counters.
  • Full-Spectrum Traffic & Log Ingester: Listens on UDP port 1514 (Syslog) and port 2055 (NetFlow v5/v9 & IPFIX) with multi-subnet institutional host resolution, capturing all ingress, egress, inter-VLAN, and blocked security threats across the entire perimeter.
  • InfluxDB 2.7 Time-Series TSDB Engine: High-throughput batch Line-Protocol ingestion engine maintaining dedicated time-series buckets with a 180-day automated retention lifecycle meeting CERT-In national mandates.
  • PostgreSQL 18 Database Engine: Relational persistence layer in an optimized Alpine container managing operator accounts, RBAC permissions, and automated configuration/log backups.
  • Reactive Vue 3.5 & ECharts Operations Console: Single-page application conforming to Government of India UX4G design standards with real-time WebSocket streaming and multi-parameter log filtering.

2. Visual Interface Tour

2.1 Authentication & First-Time Setup Wizard

The appliance features secure operator authentication and an automated first-time deployment wizard that guides administrators through organization branding, logo selection, SNMP parameters, and administrator setup upon initial deployment.

Figure 1: UX4G Secure Operator Authentication Portal Authentication
Figure 2: Turnkey First-Time Configuration Wizard (Virtual Appliance Ready) Onboarding

2.2 Executive Telemetry Dashboard

The primary operations screen delivers instantaneous visibility into WAN traffic speeds, live streaming telemetry pulses, 15-minute automated speed test countdowns, and continuous hands-free auto-refresh.

Figure 3: Live Executive Telemetry Dashboard with Inbound/Outbound Velocity Gauges Operations

2.3 Bento-Style Traffic & Flow Analyzer

The Bento layout provides actionable network intelligence: mapping IP addresses to applications (App-ID), pinpointing top uploaders and downloaders, and resolving machine hostnames.

Figure 4: Bento-Grid Traffic Analyzer (App-ID, Top Uploaders & Downloaders) Flow Analytics

2.4 Comprehensive FortiGate SNMP Telemetry Center

Dedicated hardware and environmental telemetry cockpit: monitoring CPU/RAM, session counts, 46+ physical ports and departmental VLANs, thermal zones, cooling fans, dual AC power supplies, and FortiOS UTM threat counters.

Figure 5: High-Performance FortiGate SNMP Hardware & Environmental Center SNMP Hardware

2.5 Security Policies & Conflict Engine

Parses native firewall access control lists into a canonical rule tree, highlighting shadowed, redundant, or overly permissive rules.

Figure 6: Canonical Policy Governance & Shadow Conflict Detection Security Audit

2.6 Full-Spectrum Firewall Traffic & Log Analyzer (InfluxDB 2.7 TSDB Engine)

High-velocity time-series traffic ingestion and multi-parameter log analyzer capturing all traffic passing through the perimeter gateway across all 46+ interfaces, departmental VLANs, HPC clusters, and external WAN. Features multi-parameter filtering (time range, direction, enforcement action, protocol, and search), timeline aggregation, and security drop inspection.

Figure 7: InfluxDB Traffic & Threat Ingestion Velocity Analytics (Allowed vs Blocked) TSDB Analytics
Figure 8: Deep Multi-Parameter Log Explorer & Live Stream Table (All Subnets & Blocked Threats) Log Explorer

2.7 CERT-In Section 70B Compliance & Cybersecurity Baseline

Dedicated compliance dashboard validating firewall operational controls against the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) Section 70B directives, including 180-day secure time-series log retention and Stratum-1 IST NTP clock synchronization.

Figure 9: CERT-In National Cyber Security Baseline Compliance Dashboard Compliance

2.8 User Management & System Configuration

Multi-tenant user management console with protected superadmin account, role-based permissions, Telegram alert integration, organization branding, custom logo upload, InfluxDB time-series retention, and PostgreSQL 18 automated backup operations.

Figure 10: User Management & Telegram Alert Configuration RBAC
Figure 11: Institutional Branding, Custom Logo & PostgreSQL 18 / InfluxDB 2.7 Engines Administration
